segments.oily: One older reviewer with oily skin, living in a hot and humid climate, reports this cleanser finally gets her face squeaky clean before her moisturizing routine.
segments.dry: One reviewer whose skin has grown drier with age reports her face feels clean without being over-stripped; another who uses it more than twice a week finds it dries her skin out a little and limits use to once or twice weekly as a result.
segments.combination: One reviewer in her 40s with combination skin and some fine lines and wrinkles reports it cleanses gently without breaking her out.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one who calls hers extremely sensitive, report no irritation and no stripping, even paired with a cleansing brush.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin reports her skin feels great and not stripped after use, using it alone in the morning and after an oil cleanser at night.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature skin in their 60s report soft, hydrated, refreshed skin, with one pairing it with a pro-collagen moisturizer at night.

concerns.aging: Reviewers identifying as having aging or mature skin report the cleanser suits their skin well without over-drying or stripping it, though none describe a direct reduction in fine lines or wrinkles from this cleanser specifically.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report the cleanser does not dry out or tighten their skin, several specifically noting no stripped or tight feeling; however, one reviewer found it very drying and stopped use, and another limits use to once or twice a week because it dries her skin out a little.
concerns.redness: One reviewer bought this specifically to reduce redness after a virtual skin consultation and reports it diminishing after two weeks of use; another simply notes her face is never red or rough afterward.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including one managing adult acne, report no breakouts from this cleanser over months of use; one reviewer, however, suspects it may be contributing to breakouts, though she is unsure whether the cause is this cleanser or a moisturizer she started at the same time.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin in a hot, humid climate reports it leaves her face squeaky clean, and another describes the finish as balanced, neither dry nor oily.

Removes makeup well for most users
Pump dispenser, concentrated formula lasts long
Can sting or burn if it reaches the eyes

extraits.titre: So glad to have finished the bottle
extraits.texte: I purchased this during the 50% off sale, thinking, *how bad could it be?* Unfortunately, it turned out to be the worst cleanser I've ever used. First, it burns your eyes. The packaging says to avoid the eye area, which I've never seen with a cleanser before. This is not only inconvenient but also challenging because you have to avoid your forehead as well to prevent it from dripping into your eyes. If you wear makeup, like I do, this makes it even less practical. On top of that, it never left my skin feeling truly clean. I would avoid this product at all costs.

I bought this product. The smell of it is SO BAD!!! I tried it once and I could not stand the smell. I was hoping it would have the clean smell like the cleansing balm. I also felt it was very drying. I REACHED OUT TO CUSTOMER SERVICE AND I HAVE HEARD NOTHING BACK. HUGE DISAPPOINTMENT!!!!!!

I love the product. One pump is enough for a deep face wash and it smells very nice as well. My face feels clean and not over stripped or dried out. I'm of the age where my skin is much dryer than it used to be and so far this is a good product for my aging skin.

My favorite Elemis face wash. I'm 62 have very sensitive skin and absolutely adore this wash! It lathers nicely, leaves no trace of makeup behind, my skin never feels dried out, and has a lovely spa scent. I hope this soap is never discontinued. It truly is wonderful!

I like this cleanser and have now purchased it 3 times. I tend to switch brands but this one is definitely a winner for me. I have 40's skin and some fine lines/wrinkles and a combo skin type. This does not break me out, it's gentle but leaves my skin feeling clean.

I purchased this to help diminish redness, after I used the Elemis virtual face recommendation….been using for 2 weeks and notice the redness diminishing!! I enjoy the scent, using it with the Superfood Oil…seems to be doing its job!😉

I'm older, have oily skin, and live in a hot, humid environment so finding the right product has been a challenge. I needed a good cleansing agent that leaves my face squeaky clean before using my moisturizing face wash. This product works perfect for me. Will buy again.
